title: iTrialSpace
name: iTrialSpace
description: Cohort-by-specification engine for lung-CT AI: declare a virtual trial by prevalence, nodule size, lobe distribution, and demographics; synthesize anatomically grounded CTs; evaluate CADe/CADx/VLMs under controlled conditions. 13 trial modes, 44K+ synthetic volumes, and a zero-shot VLM benchmark.
